Class PathParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractChipParameterRenderer
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.UriParameterRenderer
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.PathParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<Object>
public class PathParameterRenderer extends UriParameterRenderer
A specialized parameter renderer for an individual file path string.

It extends UriParameterRenderer to convert a file path to a file: URI, enabling the same compact chip UI and host IDE navigation. When placed inside a collection, it is composed by a list container such as WrapListParameterRenderer.
